### ITERATION 1 CONSTRAINTS
[S]: Accurately report patient's stated feelings and symptoms; do not invert or misrepresent their statements.
[O]: Report all objective measurements (e.g., temperature, BP) exactly as stated in the transcript, including units. Do not convert units unless explicitly instructed.

### ITERATION 2 CONSTRAINTS
[S-Section]: Accurately report patient's stated feelings and symptoms; do not invert or misrepresent their statements.
[O-Section]: Report all objective measurements (e.g., temperature, BP) verbatim as stated in the transcript, including original units. Under no circumstances convert units unless a specific conversion instruction is provided within the prompt itself.

### ITERATION 3 CONSTRAINTS
[A-Section]: Avoid making unstated clinical inferences or causal connections between conditions unless explicitly stated by the provider.
